en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town taken from a wooded hillside. In the foreground are rocks and tall trees; beyond them lies a dense urban area with multi‑storey stone buildings, factory chimneys and railway tracks. A large church with a tall spire stands prominently to the right. Low mountains rise in the background. Handwritten white text is visible at the bottom of the image.
